nodes.label: WeChat screenshot tool
nodes.rationale: Lightweight capture-annotate-send tool baked into WeChat Desktop; philosophy is minimal, fast, chat-first. Spec was corrected via a hands-on click-by-click exploration of the real Windows client (Alt+A) on 2026-07-22.

nodes.label: Shottr (macOS)
nodes.rationale: Native, Apple-Silicon-optimized pro-grade screenshot utility (~2.3MB, 17ms capture); targets designers/developers needing pixel-level precision. Sets the pro-toolset and performance bar (~165ms to editor).

nodes.label: Live coordinate + HEX color crosshair (pre-drag)
nodes.rationale: WeChat crosshair shows LOC x,y and HEX #rrggbb before any drag, folding a zero-extra-step color picker into the capture trigger; cheap because it reads the already-frozen frame buffer.

nodes.label: Rectangle-filled / Ellipse-outline asymmetry
nodes.rationale: Verified deliberate-looking inconsistency in WeChat's toolbar: Rectangle draws filled solid color while Ellipse is outline-only, same swatch/session; ProShottr must decide fill defaults deliberately rather than assume.

nodes.label: Sticker/emoji picker panel
nodes.rationale: Full first-class picker (Recent row + All Stickers grid + category tabs), not an inline quick-row; placed stickers center in selection and are repositionable.

nodes.label: Mosaic with AI-masking toggle
nodes.rationale: WeChat Mosaic has a manual brush-size picker plus a dedicated AI-masking toggle implying auto-detection of sensitive regions (faces/text); modeled as two first-class separately-toggleable modes, not folded into manual mosaic.

nodes.label: OCR 'Extract Text' result viewer window
nodes.rationale: Extract Text opens a dedicated floating window (image preview with pin/history/zoom/rotate + a side panel of copyable OCR lines + a '...' overflow menu), not a silent clipboard copy; model as a real reusable secondary overlay surface.

nodes.label: Send directly to chat/destination
nodes.rationale: WeChat's signature zero-friction 'send straight to destination' step; exact instant-send vs attach-to-compose semantics left unverified because clicking on a live account risks posting to a real contact. ProShottr approximates via OS sharesheets/deep-links.

nodes.label: Pin to screen (floating window)
nodes.rationale: Both apps pin; WeChat pin spawns a real lightweight always-on-top window with its own minimize/close controls (not just a borderless overlay); Shottr adds scroll-to-resize.

nodes.label: Scrolling screenshot (stitching)
nodes.rationale: Shottr auto-stitches long pages/chats/docs into one tall image; identified as ProShottr's hardest/highest-risk feature.

nodes.label: Area OCR to clipboard (+QR)
nodes.rationale: Shottr live area OCR parses selected text to clipboard and also decodes QR codes; strong Chinese + English support is a shared market requirement.

nodes.label: Feature Analysis: WeChat vs Shottr
nodes.rationale: Feature source-of-truth cataloguing both inspiration tools so ProShottr can decide what to adopt, merge, or improve.
